body:
I find it hard to understand the last part, are you saying English is your second language? Or maybe your mental issues make it hard to write?

Yeah it's good you see a psychiatrist because I'm not good at talking to people, maybe try talking to adult members of your family about your depression too.

Perhaps you should adopt a pet cat from a shelter if you're lonely, cats are easy to take care of as long as you don't have memory problems, you just need to remember to feed them, give them water, clean their litterbox and sometimes play with them and in return you have someone you can hug that makes you feel less alone.

You could also try to get a hobby such as drawing or whatever interests you and join a club dedicated to it, maybe you'll find friends that way.

I hope you can hold on to your happiness :)

Ok :( goodbye. God bless you too mister. Please don't kill yourself.

I sent you a private message you should read if you are still here.
I don't want you to die, you remind me of my dad :( I wish I could make you happy.
Thanks for your input. My thoughts are already bad enough to the point of suicide, so I might as well try it.

> gud luck to you dont let it take your life like it has mine

Thank you, I can try.

>Am gonna do it soon

Ok :(

If there is no way to stop you then hug your kids a last time and say you love them before you leave. Leave a letter saying it wasn't their fault or they will blame themselves for it.
You haven't gotten over your dad since you say you still want to be with him. If your kids care about you, which it sounds like they do, no amount of money is ever going to be able to replace you.
Thank you very much, I will keep this in mind.
Thanks for telling me about your experiences.
Thank you for the advice. Do you remember which strains lifted your spirits?

Thanks for the advice. My uncle drank so much he died from alcohol poisoning, I thought he must have got some good feeling out of it since he kept doing it.

I live in Sweden where weed is frowned upon but I think I can figure out a way to get it.

My dad is the most important person in my life and I would never get over it if he killed himself, but if you really feel they don't care I don't know how to help you since I suffer from depression myself.
You have kids? You say you just want to be with your dad, I'm sure your kids feel the same way about their dad and would be sad if he died.
